appraisal_events.evidence: Albertine insists Léa was "parfaitement convenable" during their trip, only "less free" in her vocabulary, a claim so thin that "il me semblait qu'une partie du roman... tombait enfin en cendres"
appraisal_events.explanation: Albertine's attempt to minimize the Léa trip reads as another hollow deflection, further eroding what little of the narrator's trust in her account remained.

status_effects.explanation: This additional, transparently inadequate reassurance modestly extends the passage's ongoing erosion of Albertine's credibility.
